name: Ukusetyenziswa kweziyobisi kunye nokuba likhoboka
tagline: Utywala, iziyobisi - indlela yokuyiqonda, apho ungalufumana khona uncedo.
sources: SANCA (South African National Council on Alcoholism and Drug Dependence)

urgent.heading: Urgent — tsalela umnxeba ngoku if
urgent.primary_message: Ukugqithisa ngokweqile, ukurhoxa kakhulu, okanye iingcinga zokuzenzakalisa zifuna uncedo olukhawulezileyo. Musa ukulinda. Musa ukuba wedwa.
red_flags: Akukho zingqondweni, kunzima ukuvuka, okanye ukungaphenduli emva kokusetyenziswa
Ukuphefumla kancinci kakhulu, ngokungaqhelekanga, okanye hayi kwaphela (ingakumbi ngeeopioids ezifana neheroin okanye iwhoonga)
Imilebe eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, iinzipho, okanye ubuso
Ukugabha kakhulu okungayekiyo, ingakumbi ukuba uyozela
Ukuxhuzula ngexesha lokurhoxiswa - ngakumbi utywala okanye i-benzodiazepines
Ukubhideka kakhulu, ukungcangcazela, ukubona izinto ezingekhoyo, okanye umkhuhlane
Iingcamango zokuzenzakalisa, ukuzibulala, okanye ukwenzakalisa omnye umntu

what_is_it.heading: Ukusetyenziswa kweziyobisi ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Ukusetyenziswa kweziyobisi kuba yingxaki xa iqala ukwenzakalisa impilo yakho, ubudlelwane bakho, umsebenzi wakho, okanye indlela oziva ngayo - kwaye xa ufumanisa ukuba awukwazi ukuyeka, nokuba ufuna.
paragraphs: Ukukhotyokiswa yimeko yezonyango, kungekhona ukusilela kwimilinganiselo yokuziphatha. I-substance iyayitshintsha indlela umvuzo wengqondo kunye neenkqubo zoxinzelelo ezisebenza ngayo, ukwenza usetyenziso oluqhubekayo luzive luyimfuneko ukuze uzive uqhelekileyo. Yiyo loo nto amandla ewodwa ehlala engonelanga - kwaye kutheni unyango lubalulekile.

EMzantsi Afrika, utywala bubangela owona monakalo kude kude, kulandele i-methamphetamine (i-tik, ngakumbi eNtshona Koloni), i-cannabis, i-heroin kunye ne-'whoonga'/nyaope (iziyobisi zasesitalatweni ezisekelwe kwi-heroin), kunye namayeza abhalwe ngugqirha. Indlela yokuphuma yahlukile kumntu ngamnye, kodwa zonke ziqala ngenyathelo elifanayo - ukufikelela.

items.headline: Imeko yezonyango
items.body: Ukukhotyokiswa yimeko yonyango eyaziwayo ebandakanya ukutshintsha kwengqondo. Unyango luyasebenza - ukuchacha kuyinyani.

items.headline: Eqhelekileyo
items.body: Malunga nomntu om-1 kwaba-5 eMzantsi Afrika uya kulwa nengxaki yokusebenzisa iziyobisi ngaxa lithile. Ukude wedwa.

items.headline: USANCA simahla
items.body: I-SANCA iqhuba amaziko ovavanyo kunye nonyango lwasimahla kuMzantsi Afrika wonke. I-Detox, ingcebiso, kunye ne-rehab - akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo.

items.headline: Ukurhoxa kuyinyani
items.body: Utywala kunye nokuhoxiswa kwe-benzodiazepine kunokubeka ubomi esichengeni - ungaze uyeke i-turkey ebandayo yedwa. I-detox yonyango ikhuselekile kwaye isimahla kwiikliniki ezininzi.

pull_quote.text: Ukuchacha akukho malunga nokuba namandla. Kumalunga nokufumana uncedo olululo ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Umntu ocela uncedo kube kanye ayinguye lo ebeluthwele yedwa — sele enesibindi.

signs.heading: Iimpawu ezisetyenziswayo ziye zaba yingxaki
signs.lede: Ukusetyenziswa kweziyobisi kwi-spectrum - ukusuka ekusebenziseni, ekusetyenzisweni kakubi, ukuya ekuxhomekekeni. Awudingi ukuba phantsi kwelitye ukuze ucele uncedo. Kwangaphambili kulula.

items.title: Ifuna ngaphezulu
items.description: Ukusebenzisa ngaphezu kokuba ubuqhele ukwenza kwisiphumo esifanayo. Ukusela ngaphambi kosuku. Ukusebenzisa xa uwedwa, okanye into yokuqala ekuseni. Ukufihla imali kwabanye.

items.title: Andikwazi ukuyeka
items.description: Ukuzama ukugawula kwaye kuyasilela. Izithembiso kuwe okanye kwabanye ongenakukwazi ukuzigcina. Ukusebenzisa nangona uyazi ukuba kubangela ingozi kwimpilo yakho, usapho, okanye umsebenzi.

items.title: Iimpawu zokurhoxa
items.description: Ukuziva ugula (ukungcangcazela, ukubila, isicaphucaphu, ukuxhalaba) xa ungayisebenzisanga kwiiyure ezimbalwa. Ukusebenzisa nje ukuziva uqhelekile, kungekhona ukuziva uphakamileyo. Uphawu olucacileyo umzimba ulungelelanise.

items.fact: Amashumi eminyaka ophando lwengqondo abonisa ukuba umlutha ubandakanya utshintsho lokwenyani kwiisekethe zobuchopho - umvuzo, uxinzelelo, ukwenza izigqibo. Yimeko yonyango esabelayo kunyango, kungekhona isiphene somlingiswa.

items.myth: Kufuneka ubethe ezantsi etyeni phambi kokuba unyango lusebenze.
items.fact: Kwangaphambili kulula. Abantu abafumana uncedo ngelixa besasebenza, besekusapho, basasebenza banamazinga aphezulu kakhulu okubuyisela kunabo balinda de kulahlekwe yonke into.

items.myth: Ndimele ndikwazi ukuyeka ngokwam. Ukucela uncedo kuthetha ukuba ndoyisakele.
items.fact: Uninzi lwabantu abachachayo kubukhoboka bafumana uncedo lobuchwephesha. Ukuzama uwedwa kunezinga elisezantsi kakhulu lempumelelo. Ukucela uncedo yeyona nto isebenzayo onokuyenza.

Ukuchacha kuyinyani kwaye kuhlala ixesha elide kubantu abaninzi. Ubuchopho butshintsha ekusetyenzisweni kweziyobisi kunokuphilisa ngexesha kunye nonyango. Izigidi ezininzi zabantu ziye zakha ngokutsha ubomi bazo.

items.title: Tsalela umnxeba i-SANCA — uvavanyo lwasimahla kunye nokuthunyelwa
items.description: I-0861 472 622 iya kukuqhagamshela kwisebe le-SANCA elikufutshane kuwe. Bamamela, bavavanye, babhekiselele kunyango lwasimahla. Akukho sigqibo.

items.title: Ungazami ukukhupha utywala wedwa
items.description: Ukuyeka utywala kakhulu kunokubangela ukuxhuzula kunye nokufa. Ukuba usela kakhulu yonke imihla, thetha nekliniki phambi kokuba uyeke. I-detox yonyango isimahla kwaye ikhuseleke kakhulu.

items.title: Ukuba usebenzisa i-opioids - yazi malunga ne-overdose
items.description: I-heroin, i-whoonga, kunye nezithomalalisi zentlungu ezichazwe ngugqirha zinokuyeka ukuphefumla. Ungaze usebenzise wedwa ukuba unokukuphepha. I-Naloxone ibuyisela umva i-overdose — buza i-SANCA ukuba iyifumana phi.

items.title: Xelela umntu omnye omthembileyo
items.description: Ilungu losapho, umhlobo, inkokeli yenkolo, ugqirha - nabani na omthembayo kakhulu. Ukuyithetha ngokuvakalayo kanye kophula imfihlo egcina iqhubeka.

items.title: Ukuba umntu omthandayo usebenzisa
items.description: Thetha ngokuxhalabileyo, hayi ukoyikisa. 'Ndiyakuthanda kwaye ndinexhala' unamandla ngakumbi kunokuba 'kufuneka uyeke'. U-SANCA ukwanceda iintsapho - hayi abasebenzisi kuphela.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Unyango lokusetyenziswa kweziyobisi eMzantsi Afrika lufikeleleka ngakumbi kunokuba abantu abaninzi becinga. Amasebe eSANCA akhona kuwo onke amaziko amakhulu. Iiklinikhi zikarhulumente zibonelela nge-detox yonyango. Uncedo lusondele kunokuba ucinga.
